title: nepeta vivianii
intro: Nepeta vivianii, commonly known as Vivian's Catmint, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. This herb is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, and is used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, due to its calming and sedative effects. The health benefits of Nepeta vivianii include its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation, and it is also used as a natural remedy for digestive issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Nepeta vivianii include rosmarinic acid, nepetalactone, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
